# Portuguese Inquisition pages (TraPrInq)

Three pages from the final validation set of *Portuguese Handwriting 16th-19th c.*, by Hervé Baudry, Susana Tavares Pedro, Marize Helena de Campos et al. (TraPrInq project, CHAM, 2024), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13986218, licensed CC BY 4.0. The images are shown as PDFs and the expert transcriptions as text, otherwise unchanged. Picked pages: 0001_page_44127202_docId_1074485.xml, PT-TT-TSO-IL-28-3642_m0005.xml, PT-TT-TSO-IL-28-8137_c0039.xml.
